case.title: Calm cancellation request
case.subject: Cancelling
case.text:
Hello, I'm retiring at the end of the year and closing my massage practice, so I'd like to cancel my Slotwise subscription. Thank you for the good service over the years. What happens to my client list?

George
case.why: Cancellation is self-serve; not angry, so no escalation. Reply should explain steps, export, and 30-day data retention.

output.reply:
Hello George,

Congratulations on your retirement, and thank you for being with us over the years.

You can cancel yourself at any time, with no cancellation fee and no notice period:
1. Sign in as the account owner (staff accounts cannot cancel).
2. Go to Settings → Billing → Cancel subscription.
3. Choose a reason (optional) and confirm.

What happens to your client list and data:
- Your account stays active until the end of the current billing period, and you won't be charged again.
- Your booking page goes offline at the end of that period and no more reminders are sent.
- Your data, including your client list, is kept for 30 days after the period ends. If you reactivate within those 30 days, everything is restored as it was. After 30 days it is permanently deleted.

Before you cancel, we recommend exporting your client list and appointment history: go to Settings → Data → Export, choose clients, appointments, payments or everything, and click Create export. You will receive an email with a download link (CSV files in a ZIP) within about 15 minutes, valid for 7 days. Only the owner and admins can export.

It's also a good idea to let your clients know your booking link will stop working. Please note that cancelling does not trigger a refund of the current billing period.

Wishing you all the best for your retirement.

Kind regards,
Slotwise Support
